mentions.note: 90th birthday 9 August 1984; joined Belgrave 1927 from Polytechnic Harriers; 8th in the Yacht '3'; bronze team medal South of Thames Senior 1928; first Belgrave man home in the National at Leamington; elected Captain; Hon. Treasurer from 1943 for 14 years; club President 1948-50; presented with a cut-glass decanter at Belgrave Hall on 11 August 1984
